facts.text: 95-Megapixel CCD Focal Plane was deployed at Earth-Trailing Heliocentric Orbit during Kepler Space Telescope in 2009.
Focal plane array of 42 science CCDs covering a massive 115 square-degree field of view, measuring minute stellar brightness dips down to 20 parts per million.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Discovered Kepler-186f and Kepler-452b, the first confirmed Earth-radius exoplanets orbiting in the habitable zones of their host stars.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Earth-Trailing Heliocentric Orbit.
A permanent human and robotic monument celebrating space exploration on the Moon.
